author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
This is an experiment that's been in the back of my mind since before the 100% Apple Pie actually.  A chocolate chip cookie, made from 100% chocolate chips!

Join the Atomic Shrimp official Discord server for FREE early access to videos! - https://discord.gg/atomicshrimp  
Atomic Shrimp subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/AtomicShrimp/

The cookie recipe I used in the first part of this video is based on this one: https://www.jamieoliver.com/recipes/chocolate/chocolate-chip-cookies/
title: 100% Choc Chips - This Cookie Contains ONLY Chocolate Chips
